body.name: \mathcal C_{n,\alpha}
body.construction: For \((r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en})\in[0,\bar r]^3\) and a constant \(K_{\alpha}\) depending only on \(\alpha\) and the supplied class constants, set \(\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}=[\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{med}}-K_{\alpha}\rho_n,\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{med}}+K_{\alpha}\rho_n]\), and define \(\mathfrak L_{n,\alpha}=\inf_{C_n\in\mathcal I_n:\inf_{\mathcal M_n}P\{\tau(P)\in C_n\}\ge1-\alpha}\sup_{\mathcal M_n}E_P[\operatorname{length}(C_n)]\).
